capabilities.label: Appointments
capabilities.description: Book, check, cancel and reschedule appointments.

existingAppointment.label: If the caller already has an upcoming appointment

optionLabels.confirm: Check with them first — only book a second one if they say yes
optionLabels.block: Don't book a second one — offer to move the existing one

identity.label: What must the caller provide before we look up or change an appointment?

confirmBeforeWrite.label: Read details back and require a clear yes before booking

businessHoursOnly.label: Only allow booking changes during opening hours

capacity.label: How many appointments can share one time slot

notes.label: Anything specific about how you book?
notes.placeholder: e.g. Ask if they're a new or existing patient first

capabilities.label: Messages & callbacks
capabilities.description: Take a message from any caller. A callback request is just a message flagged to call them back — same record, sorted for your team. Always on.

identity.label: What must the caller provide before we take a message?

notes.label: Anything specific about how you take messages?
notes.placeholder: e.g. Always ask which department the message is for

capabilities.label: Quote requests
capabilities.description: Collect pricing enquiries and pass them to your team.

identity.label: What must the caller provide before we log a quote request?

notes.label: Anything specific about how you quote?
notes.placeholder: e.g. Always ask whether it's an emergency. Never quote a price on the phone.

capabilities.label: Transfer to a person
capabilities.description: Hand the caller to a human when they ask or when we cannot help.
